verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with AI features (Seer), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented control that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The `include_prompts=False` setting only controls whether AI prompt content is captured in the SDK, which is an adjacent control. Self-hosting is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
